name: ServiceActivator
summary: Connects a channel to a service the application already has, so that the same service can be reached by a message and by an ordinary call without knowing which happened.

roles.name: ServiceActivator
roles.summary: The participant that consumes the message and invokes the service like any other client. It handles every messaging detail, and may be one-way or half of a request-reply, so that whether the caller arrived over a channel is a fact the service never has to learn.

roles.name: Service
roles.summary: What is being made available. Naming it is what makes the pattern's claim checkable: a service that has acquired a message type in its signature, or a reply channel in its parameters, is no longer invocable by anything but the activator.
